questions.question_text:
RECALL AND CONNECT 2:
a) What are fossil fuels?
b) What are the advantages and disadvantages of using fossil fuels?

marking_scheme.rubric: AO1 and AO2: Answer cross-topic questions on resource provision.
keywords_required: a) Fossil fuels are non-renewable energy resources formed from the remains of dead plants and animals over millions of years (coal, oil, natural gas).
b) Advantages: Relatively cheap, reliable, produce large amounts of energy.
b) Disadvantages: Non-renewable (will run out), release greenhouse gases (CO2) causing global warming, release sulfur dioxide causing acid rain.

Under international agreements, which of the following activities are banned in Antarctica?
collecting scientific data, military operations, disposal of nuclear waste, tourism, commercial fishing, mining

marking_scheme.rubric: AO1: Identify activities banned by the Antarctic Treaty system.

questions.question_text:
Use the words below to fill in the gaps about international agreements to protect wildlife in Antarctica.
International Association of Antarctic Tour Operators (IAATO), Polar Code, Marine Protected Areas (MPAs), International Whaling Commission (IWC)

The ________ imposed a quota system in the 1970s on all parties hunting whales. Two large ________ have been established in the Antarctic to protect biodiversity through protecting those areas from commercial activities. The International Maritime Organization implemented a ________ in 2017 that limits the operation of very large cruise ships in Antarctica. The ________ is working on putting laws in place to manage tourism to the region to limit harm caused by human activity.

marking_scheme.rubric: AO1: Correctly place the organizations and agreements.
keywords_required: 4. International Association of Antarctic Tour Operators (IAATO)
